basis: Retain reviewed R3.4 feasibility bounds: ready5s,parse15s,main longtask100ms,cancel500ms,timeout cleanup1s,window60,post-GC main growth30MiB. Runtime current r75 watchdog is actually15s; formal App fault run must wait it, no clock acceleration.
Existing R3.4 fixture generator and original Y06 sizes form a five-size union. No easier replacement corpus. Exact byte/code-unit hashes are separately frozen.

Exploratory exact packaged Node Worker10MiB parse268ms and observed isolate heap151.4MiB; App10MiB parse326ms,first window387.1ms,observed retained Worker heap143426896bytes. Fix Worker metadata observer to WeakRef before judging GC: first strong-reference observation retained callbacks/editor; corrected five-file closed-main growth2734096bytes. Both raw runs preserved.

Worker retained-heap ceiling256MiB and renderer peak working-set ceiling1GiB are pre-formal engineering bounds, roughly1.7x current raw high-water values, not retrospective user SLA or OS limits. App reports Electron working/peak-working-set in KiB, converted to bytes. Worker heap is a post-parse/window observation, not a claimed continuous heap peak; process peak is recorded separately.

Main post-GC30MiB bound means all measured document tabs closed and no source intentionally retained by the observer; active document heap and source buffers are recorded separately. UI long tasks are measured from original parse post through first real window paint, with full-source hashing/serialization outside the measured interval.

Raw Node parent tick gaps are not browser long tasks. Natural App/I samples exclude explicit transport delay, invalid-window and startup-throw faults. Formal cancellation requires actual native target destruction, not only terminate() returning.
budget.changePolicy: Frozen before formal performance acceptance. Keep failures and raw measures; never relax this budget, replace inputs, change memory scope or count partial/mocked rendering as full success to obtain a pass.

boundary: A real packaged UI, original Worker/main/RPC/native file pipeline. Natural cancellation uses actual close-button pointer input during an original10MiB parse. Faults: unchanged parse request held until original15s watchdog; private startup-throw module prefixes an explicit JS error before byte-identical original code; invalid-window copies only start=-1 to elicit real caught protocol failure. No fake Worker result/ErrorEvent/Store writes. Parser U/I covers all corrupt JS strings; App actual file pipeline must reject NUL/unsupported UTF16 losslessly as its existing encoding contract requires. No runtime corpus/budget change, models, clipboard, daily data or external launch.
